# Common source-collection pre-code observations

[First sources](attempt-01/) and [context](context.md) are retained before the
first check. [Identity](identity-before.json) separates the existing compiled
production from subsequent record-only HEADs. The [session](session.json)
appends actual results; no historical source or diagnostic is rewritten.

The fixed capture driver will support separate before/after directories and
retain exact small untrusted proposals. This is a loader/profile study, not
canonical stdlib publication or semantic/theorem evidence.
